scenarios.title: Known topic
scenarios.setup_or_action: New session; select Q07.
scenarios.expected: Host validates ID and starts a Q07 target episode with accepted item; no blanket foundation pretest.

scenarios.title: Free-text mapping
scenarios.setup_or_action: Describe equations with brackets.
scenarios.expected: Propose Q07; no target commit until confirmation; unknown ID rejected.

scenarios.title: Unsure
scenarios.setup_or_action: No topic supplied; choose starting-point help.
scenarios.expected: Orientation starts Q06 seed, one accepted item at a time; no placement pass.

scenarios.title: Public task
scenarios.setup_or_action: Apply valid signed Q07 task token.
scenarios.expected: New learner session uses Q07; task creator gains no report access.

scenarios.title: Forged task
scenarios.setup_or_action: Change target or add success_count/policy in signed task.
scenarios.expected: Reject signature/allowlist; no trusted settings or progress created.

scenarios.title: Orientation cap
scenarios.setup_or_action: Present six items without narrowed evidence.
scenarios.expected: Provisional trial or choice with uncertainty; at most eight under clarification rule.

scenarios.title: Not learned
scenarios.setup_or_action: Select not learned during orientation.
scenarios.expected: Record NOT_LEARNED, not incorrect; no learner deficit or failure counter.

scenarios.title: Orientation success
scenarios.setup_or_action: Correct Q06, Q07 and Q08 orientation responses.
scenarios.expected: Item observations only; no three-item target criterion or grade/RIT claim.

scenarios.title: Distribution journey
scenarios.setup_or_action: Q07 attempt shows incomplete expansion; E06 probes reproduce pattern; teach; fresh varied independent E06 work; return.
scenarios.expected: Parent Q07 retained; hypothesis bounded; component/skill criterion scoped; fresh Q07 check required.

scenarios.title: Deeper repair
scenarios.setup_or_action: Declared prerequisite of repair skill needs investigation.
scenarios.expected: Push return frame and descend relevant edge; unwind each parent with fresh evidence.

scenarios.title: Switch target
scenarios.setup_or_action: Change from Q07 during E06 repair to another supported topic.
scenarios.expected: Suspend old episode; replace active curriculum block; preserve interrupted stack without mixing streaks.

scenarios.title: Single correct probe
scenarios.setup_or_action: Wrong target answer followed by correct contrast.
scenarios.expected: Original error not reproduced; no confirmed slip or automatic pass.

scenarios.title: Alternative dependencies
scenarios.setup_or_action: Load Q10 or another alternative-path node.
scenarios.expected: Select relevant conditional route; do not require every alternative jointly.

scenarios.title: Budget boundary
scenarios.setup_or_action: Three failed repair check cycles after intervening instruction.
scenarios.expected: Pause/route with scoped observations; do not diagnose foundational incapacity.

scenarios.title: Stop while pending
scenarios.setup_or_action: END_SESSION while provider output is pending.
scenarios.expected: Cancel lease, preserve accepted work, close with partial report; late output discarded.

scenarios.title: Resume
scenarios.setup_or_action: Reload valid current session, then explicitly resume a closed retained session.
scenarios.expected: No duplicate scoring; restore only validated retained context and mode.

scenarios.title: Hint independence
scenarios.setup_or_action: Request hint before responding correctly.
scenarios.expected: Support committed before display; correct answer assisted and excluded from streak.

scenarios.title: Freshness
scenarios.setup_or_action: Reuse solved item with a new item ID.
scenarios.expected: Fingerprint detects reuse; no independent credit.

scenarios.title: Numeric-only skill
scenarios.setup_or_action: Three correct numeric answers on a skill requiring conceptual evidence.
scenarios.expected: Only component criterion met; whole skill remains partial/review required.

scenarios.title: Immediate versus retention
scenarios.setup_or_action: Three varied fully eligible successes in one session.
scenarios.expected: Immediate criterion only; no durable mastery or delayed retention claim.

scenarios.title: Correction cascade
scenarios.setup_or_action: Invalidate an earlier credited item after checker conflict.
scenarios.expected: Append correction, recompute dependent streaks and claims, preserve original record.

scenarios.title: Untested map
scenarios.setup_or_action: Report at end of one Q07 journey.
scenarios.expected: No pass/fail labels for untested curriculum skills; next evidence scoped.

scenarios.title: Exact rational
scenarios.setup_or_action: Submit 0.5 for expected 1/2 when exact decimal is allowed.
scenarios.expected: Correct; requested form checked separately when relevant.

scenarios.title: Near number
scenarios.setup_or_action: Submit 8 for expected 7.
scenarios.expected: Incorrect, irrespective of edit distance.

scenarios.title: Polynomial expansion
scenarios.setup_or_action: Expand 3(x+2): submit 3x+6 then 3x+2.
scenarios.expected: First correct numeric-symbolic component; second incorrect; no random-substitution proof.

scenarios.title: Complete roots
scenarios.setup_or_action: Solve x^2=9: submit {3} then {-3,3}.
scenarios.expected: First incomplete/PARTIAL; second complete; sqrt(9) remains 3 in a distinct task.

scenarios.title: Domain preservation
scenarios.setup_or_action: Simplify (x^2-1)/(x-1) without retaining x != 1.
scenarios.expected: Do not certify domain-complete answer; preserve original restriction.

scenarios.title: Requested form
scenarios.setup_or_action: Asked to factor x^2-1; submit x^2-1.
scenarios.expected: Equivalent expression but requested factorization not met.

scenarios.title: Unsupported representation
scenarios.setup_or_action: Graph task while graph input/checker unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Route capability boundary; no scalar substitute or student failure.

scenarios.title: Unsafe syntax
scenarios.setup_or_action: Submit code, huge exponent, zero denominator or deeply nested AST.
scenarios.expected: No eval/execution; bounded parser returns invalid/unscorable clarification without scoring failure.

scenarios.title: Ambiguity
scenarios.setup_or_action: Submit ambiguous mixed-number notation or malformed interval.
scenarios.expected: Clarify; preserve work; do not force incorrect.

scenarios.title: Duplicate submit
scenarios.setup_or_action: Repeat same idempotency key/hash after lost response.
scenarios.expected: Return original accepted result or pending; score once.

scenarios.title: Idempotency conflict
scenarios.setup_or_action: Reuse same key with different answer.
scenarios.expected: 409; no second acceptance.

scenarios.title: Stale tab
scenarios.setup_or_action: Submit old revision/item after another tab advances.
scenarios.expected: 409 and safe reload action; no progress change.

scenarios.title: Late lease
scenarios.setup_or_action: Provider returns after cancellation/lease expiry.
scenarios.expected: Result discarded; cannot overwrite current state.

scenarios.title: Empty/truncated provider
scenarios.setup_or_action: Provider emits empty or incomplete JSON.
scenarios.expected: Bounded repair/hold; no student failure and no raw output.

scenarios.title: Forged model promotion
scenarios.setup_or_action: Model emits a pass without supporting accepted events.
scenarios.expected: Host rejects transition/evidence promotion.

scenarios.title: Missing curriculum
scenarios.setup_or_action: Required canonical skill record absent.
scenarios.expected: Scoped hold, preserve parent state; no invented record.

scenarios.title: Answer leakage
scenarios.setup_or_action: Inspect public API for item/view/report.
scenarios.expected: No answer_spec, hidden rubric, private envelope, verdict hash or hypotheses in ordinary student view.

scenarios.title: Prompt injection
scenarios.setup_or_action: Learner text contains SYSTEM tags, filenames or INJECT_SKILLS markers.
scenarios.expected: Treat as text; no authority or filesystem load.

scenarios.title: Cross-session access
scenarios.setup_or_action: Use another session/item/report ID without its cookie.
scenarios.expected: Denied; IDs are not authorization.

scenarios.title: CSRF
scenarios.setup_or_action: Send mutation without valid same-origin/CSRF.
scenarios.expected: 403; no mutation or provider call.

scenarios.title: Input preservation
scenarios.setup_or_action: Provider times out after answer submission.
scenarios.expected: Retain safely accepted/pending work; explicit retry without double score/bill.

scenarios.title: Binding modes
scenarios.setup_or_action: Activation text handshake then ordinary JSON envelope.
scenarios.expected: Exact acknowledgment checked separately; JSON mode off only for activation; handshake is not enforcement proof.

scenarios.title: Context replacement
scenarios.setup_or_action: Switch area after several calls.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one fresh active curriculum block, relevant records only; no stale inventory authority.

scenarios.title: Counter binding
scenarios.setup_or_action: Replay correct verdict with a changed item version or response.
scenarios.expected: Reject mismatched result; no learner credit.

scenarios.title: Forget/expiry
scenarios.setup_or_action: Forget session or exceed idle/absolute TTL.
scenarios.expected: Delete/expire private session data per policy; no resume; no claimed backup purge absent implementation.

scenarios.title: Cost limits
scenarios.setup_or_action: Exhaust anonymous generation/spend budget.
scenarios.expected: Bounded 429/hold before another provider call; mock mode no outbound calls.

scenarios.title: Mobile keyboard
scenarios.setup_or_action: Use 360px viewport, keyboard only and screen reader status.
scenarios.expected: Controls accessible, readable math, no horizontal page overflow or lost answers.

scenarios.title: Safe rendering
scenarios.setup_or_action: Model/student text contains HTML/unsafe TeX.
scenarios.expected: Render safely; no script/link command execution.

scenarios.title: Private files
scenarios.setup_or_action: Request guessed private config/DB/curriculum-key URLs.
scenarios.expected: Unavailable outside public document root; no keys in bundled client assets.

scenarios.title: Missing extension
scenarios.setup_or_action: Run preflight without PDO_SQLite.
scenarios.expected: Clear unmet dependency; no silent text-file fallback or false deployment success.

scenarios.title: Capability matrix
scenarios.setup_or_action: Browse all 205 skill records before implementing all checkers.
scenarios.expected: Full map browsable, unsupported criteria explicit; no all-skills operational claim.
